title: Claude Code Environment Variables
description: Known environment variables accepted by Claude Code. Generated from env-vars.md.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: API key sent as X-Api-Key header. Overrides Claude.ai subscription when set.

ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Custom value for the Authorization header (prefixed with 'Bearer ').

ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL.description: Override the API endpoint to route requests through a proxy or gateway.

ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL.description: Override the Bedrock Mantle endpoint URL.

ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER.description: Bedrock service tier sent as X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier header.

ANTHROPIC_BETAS.description: Comma-separated list of additional anthropic-beta header values.

ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS.description: Custom headers to add to requests (Name: Value format, newline-separated).

ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION.description: Model ID to add as a custom entry in the /model picker.

ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_DESCRIPTIO.description: Display description for the custom model entry in the /model picker.

ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_NAME.description: Display name for the custom model entry in the /model picker.

ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_SUPPORTED_.description: Supported capabilities for the custom model option.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL.description: Override the default Haiku model ID.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_DESCRIPTIO.description: Display description for the pinned Haiku model.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_NAME.description: Display name for the pinned Haiku model.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_SUPPORTED_.description: Supported capabilities for the pinned Haiku model.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL.description: Override the default Opus model ID.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_DESCRIPTION.description: Display description for the pinned Opus model.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_NAME.description: Display name for the pinned Opus model.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_SUPPORTED_C.description: Supported capabilities for the pinned Opus model.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL.description: Override the default Sonnet model ID.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTI.description: Display description for the pinned Sonnet model.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_NAME.description: Display name for the pinned Sonnet model.

ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_SUPPORTED.description: Supported capabilities for the pinned Sonnet model.

ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY.description: API key for Microsoft Foundry authentication.

ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL.description: Full base URL for the Foundry resource.

ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE.description: Foundry resource name. Required if ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL is not set.

ANTHROPIC_MODEL.description: Name of the model setting to use.

ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL.description: [DEPRECATED] Name of Haiku-class model for background tasks.

ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL_AWS_REGION.description: Override AWS region for the Haiku-class model when using Bedrock.

ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL.description: Override the Vertex AI endpoint URL.

ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID.description: GCP project ID for Vertex AI. Required when using Google Vertex AI.

API_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout for API requests in milliseconds (default: 600000, max: 2147483647).

BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Default timeout for long-running bash commands (default: 120000).

BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH.description: Maximum number of characters in bash outputs before middle-truncation.

BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Maximum timeout the model can set for long-running bash commands (default: 600000).

CCR_FORCE_BUNDLE.description: Set to 1 to force claude --remote to bundle and upload the local repository.

CLAUDECODE.description: Set to 1 in shell environments Claude Code spawns. Use to detect Claude Code context.

CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS.description: Set to 1 to disable all built-in subagent types (non-interactive mode only).

CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_MCP_NO_PREFIX.description: Set to 1 to skip the mcp__<server>__ prefix on SDK-created MCP server tool names.

CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE.description: Context capacity percentage (1-100) at which auto-compaction triggers.

CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS.description: Set to 1 to force-enable automatic backgrounding of long-running agent tasks.

CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR.description: Return to original working directory after each Bash/PowerShell command.

CLAUDE_CODE_ACCESSIBILITY.description: Set to 1 to keep native terminal cursor visible and disable inverted-text cursor.

CLAUDE_CODE_ADDITIONAL_DIRECTORIES_CLAUD.description: Set to 1 to load memory files from directories specified with --add-dir.

CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS.description: Interval in milliseconds at which credentials should be refreshed.

CLAUDE_CODE_ATTRIBUTION_HEADER.description: Set to 0 to omit the attribution block from the system prompt.

CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW.description: Context capacity in tokens used for auto-compaction calculations.

CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE.description: Comma-separated CA certificate sources (bundled, system). Default: bundled,system.

CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_CERT.description: Path to client certificate file for mTLS authentication.

CLAUDE_CODE_CLIENT_KEY.description: Path to client private key file for mTLS authentication.

CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOGS_DIR.description: Override the debug log file path. Requires --debug or /debug to enable logging.

CLAUDE_CODE_DEBUG_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum log level written to the debug log file.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT.description: Set to 1 to disable 1M context window support.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADAPTIVE_THINKING.description: Set to 1 to disable adaptive reasoning on Opus/Sonnet 4.6.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS.description: Set to 1 to disable attachment processing.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY.description: Set to 1 to disable auto memory, 0 to force it on.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS.description: Set to 1 to disable all background task functionality.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS.description: Set to 1 to prevent loading any CLAUDE.md memory files.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON.description: Set to 1 to disable scheduled tasks.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS.description: Set to 1 to strip Anthropic-specific anthropic-beta headers from API requests.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE.description: Set to 1 to disable fast mode.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY.description: Set to 1 to disable session quality surveys.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING.description: Set to 1 to disable file checkpointing.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS.description: Set to 1 to remove built-in git commit/PR instructions from system prompt.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LEGACY_MODEL_REMAP.description: Set to 1 to prevent automatic remapping of Opus 4.0/4.1 to current version.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE.description: Set to 1 to disable mouse tracking in fullscreen rendering.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC.description: Equivalent to DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER + DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND + DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING + DISABLE_TELEMETRY.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBAC.description: Set to 1 to disable non-streaming fallback when streaming fails mid-stream.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_OFFICIAL_MARKETPLACE.description: Set to 1 to skip automatic addition of the official plugin marketplace.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_POLICY_SKILLS.description: Set to 1 to skip loading skills from system-wide managed skills directory.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE.description: Set to 1 to disable automatic terminal title updates.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING.description: Set to 1 to force-disable extended thinking.

CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_VIRTUAL_SCROLL.description: Set to 1 to disable virtual scrolling in fullscreen rendering.

CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL.description: Set the effort level for supported models.

CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_BACKGROUND_PLUGIN_REF.description: Set to 1 to refresh plugin state at turn boundaries in non-interactive mode.

CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FINE_GRAINED_TOOL_STR.description: Set to 1 to force-enable fine-grained tool input streaming (Anthropic API only).

CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION.description: Set to false to disable prompt suggestions.

CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS.description: Set to 1 to enable task tracking in non-interactive mode.

CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY.description: Set to 1 to enable OpenTelemetry data collection.

CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_STOP_DELAY.description: Time in milliseconds to wait after idle before auto-exiting.

CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS.description: Set to 1 to enable agent teams (experimental).

CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY.description: JSON object to merge into the top level of every API request body.

CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS.description: Override the default token limit for file reads.

CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT.description: Set to 1 to enable forked subagents that inherit full conversation context.

CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH.description: Windows only: path to the Git Bash executable (bash.exe).

CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_HIDDEN.description: Set to false to exclude dotfiles from Glob tool results.

CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_NO_IGNORE.description: Set to false to make Glob tool respect .gitignore patterns.

CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.description: Timeout in seconds for Glob tool file discovery (default: 20).

CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD.description: Set to 1 to hide working directory in startup logo.

CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_HOST_OVERRIDE.description: Override the host address used to connect to the IDE extension.

CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_VALID_CHECK.description: Set to 1 to skip validation of IDE lockfile entries during connection.

CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS.description: Override the context window size assumed for the active model.

CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS.description: Set the maximum number of output tokens for most requests.

CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_RETRIES.description: Override the number of times to retry failed API requests (default: 10).

CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_TOOL_USE_CONCURRENCY.description: Maximum number of read-only tools and subagents that can execute in parallel (default: 10).

CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_ALLOWLIST_ENV.description: Set to 1 to spawn stdio MCP servers with only a safe baseline environment.

CLAUDE_CODE_NEW_INIT.description: Set to 1 to make /init run an interactive setup flow.

CLAUDE_CODE_NO_FLICKER.description: Set to 1 to enable fullscreen rendering to reduce flicker.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN.description: OAuth refresh token for Claude.ai authentication.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_SCOPES.description: Space-separated OAuth scopes the refresh token was issued with.

CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.description: OAuth access token for Claude.ai authentication.

CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout in milliseconds for flushing pending OpenTelemetry spans (default: 5000).

CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_HEADERS_HELPER_DEBOUNCE.description: Interval for refreshing dynamic OpenTelemetry headers in milliseconds (default: 1740000).

CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout in milliseconds for OpenTelemetry exporter to finish on shutdown (default: 2000).

CLAUDE_CODE_PERFORCE_MODE.description: Set to 1 to enable Perforce-aware write protection.

CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_GIT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout for git operations when installing plugins (default: 120000).

CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_F.description: Set to 1 to keep existing marketplace cache when a git pull fails.

CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_SEED_DIR.description: Path to read-only plugin seed directories (: separated on Unix, ; on Windows).

CLAUDE_CODE_PROVIDER_MANAGED_BY_HOST.description: Set by host platforms that manage model provider routing on Claude Code's behalf.

CLAUDE_CODE_PROXY_RESOLVES_HOSTS.description: Set to 1 to allow the proxy to perform DNS resolution.

CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE.description: Set automatically to true when running as a cloud session.

CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID.description: Set automatically in cloud sessions to the current session ID.

CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN.description: Set to 1 to automatically resume if the previous session ended mid-turn.

CLAUDE_CODE_SCRIPT_CAPS.description: JSON object limiting how many times specific scripts may be invoked per session.

CLAUDE_CODE_SCROLL_SPEED.description: Mouse wheel scroll multiplier in fullscreen rendering (1-20).

CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Override the time budget in milliseconds for SessionEnd hooks.

CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX.description: Command prefix that wraps shell commands Claude Code spawns.

CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE.description: Set to 1 to run with a minimal system prompt and only core tools.

CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE_SYSTEM_PROMPT.description: Set to 1 to use a shorter system prompt on Opus 4.7.

CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FOUNDRY_AUTH.description: Skip Azure authentication for Microsoft Foundry.

CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_MANTLE_AUTH.description: Skip AWS authentication for Bedrock Mantle.

CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_PROMPT_HISTORY.description: Set to 1 to skip writing prompt history and session transcripts to disk.

CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB.description: Set to 1 to strip credentials from subprocess environments.

CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL.description: Set to 1 in non-interactive mode to wait for plugin installation before first query.

CLAUDE_CODE_SYNC_PLUGIN_INSTALL_TIMEOUT_.description: Timeout in milliseconds for synchronous plugin installation.

CLAUDE_CODE_SYNTAX_HIGHLIGHT.description: Set to false to disable syntax highlighting in diff output.

CLAUDE_CODE_TASK_LIST_ID.description: Share a task list across sessions by setting the same ID.

CLAUDE_CODE_TEAM_NAME.description: Name of the agent team this teammate belongs to.

CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR.description: Override the temp directory used for internal temp files.

CLAUDE_CODE_TMUX_TRUECOLOR.description: Set to 1 to allow 24-bit truecolor output inside tmux.

CLAUDE_CODE_USE_NATIVE_FILE_SEARCH.description: Set to 1 to discover custom commands using Node.js file APIs instead of ripgrep.

CLAUDE_ENABLE_BYTE_WATCHDOG.description: Force-enable (1) or force-disable (0) the byte-level streaming idle watchdog.

CLAUDE_ENABLE_STREAM_WATCHDOG.description: Set to 1 to enable the event-level streaming idle watchdog.

CLAUDE_ENV_FILE.description: Path to a shell script run before each Bash command to persist environment state.

CLAUDE_REMOTE_CONTROL_SESSION_NAME_PREFI.description: Prefix for auto-generated Remote Control session names.

CLAUDE_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout before the streaming idle watchdog closes a stalled connection (min: 300000).

DISABLE_AUTOUPDATER.description: Set to 1 to disable automatic background updates.

DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT.description: Set to 1 to disable automatic compaction when approaching context limit.

DISABLE_COMPACT.description: Set to 1 to disable all compaction (auto and manual /compact).

DISABLE_COST_WARNINGS.description: Set to 1 to disable cost warning messages.

DISABLE_DOCTOR_COMMAND.description: Set to 1 to hide the /doctor command.

DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING.description: Set to 1 to opt out of Sentry error reporting.

DISABLE_EXTRA_USAGE_COMMAND.description: Set to 1 to hide the /extra-usage command.

DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND.description: Set to 1 to disable the /feedback command.

DISABLE_GROWTHBOOK.description: Set to 1 to disable GrowthBook feature-flag fetching.

DISABLE_INSTALLATION_CHECKS.description: Set to 1 to disable installation warnings.

DISABLE_INSTALL_GITHUB_APP_COMMAND.description: Set to 1 to hide the /install-github-app command.

DISABLE_INTERLEAVED_THINKING.description: Set to 1 to prevent sending the interleaved-thinking beta header.

DISABLE_LOGIN_COMMAND.description: Set to 1 to hide the /login command.

DISABLE_LOGOUT_COMMAND.description: Set to 1 to hide the /logout command.

DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING.description: Set to 1 to disable prompt caching for all models.

DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU.description: Set to 1 to disable prompt caching for Haiku models.

DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS.description: Set to 1 to disable prompt caching for Opus models.

DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET.description: Set to 1 to disable prompt caching for Sonnet models.

DISABLE_TELEMETRY.description: Set to 1 to opt out of Statsig telemetry.

DISABLE_UPDATES.description: Set to 1 to block all updates including manual claude update.

DISABLE_UPGRADE_COMMAND.description: Set to 1 to hide the /upgrade command.

ENABLE_CLAUDEAI_MCP_SERVERS.description: Set to false to disable claude.ai MCP servers in Claude Code.

ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H.description: Set to 1 to request a 1-hour prompt cache TTL instead of default 5 minutes.

FALLBACK_FOR_ALL_PRIMARY_MODELS.description: Set to any non-empty value to trigger fallback to --fallback-model on overload.

FORCE_AUTOUPDATE_PLUGINS.description: Set to 1 to force plugin auto-updates even when main auto-updater is disabled.

FORCE_PROMPT_CACHING_5M.description: Set to 1 to force 5-minute prompt cache TTL, overriding ENABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_1H.

HTTP_PROXY.description: Specify HTTP proxy server for network connections.

HTTPS_PROXY.description: Specify HTTPS proxy server for network connections.

IS_DEMO.description: Set to 1 to enable demo mode (hides email/org, skips onboarding).

MAX_MCP_OUTPUT_TOKENS.description: Maximum tokens allowed in MCP tool responses (default: 25000).

MAX_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_RETRIES.description: Number of retries when model response fails --json-schema validation (default: 5).

MAX_THINKING_TOKENS.description: Override the extended thinking token budget. Set to 0 to disable thinking.

MCP_CLIENT_SECRET.description: OAuth client secret for MCP servers with pre-configured credentials.

MCP_CONNECTION_NONBLOCKING.description: Set to true in non-interactive mode to skip the MCP connection wait.

MCP_OAUTH_CALLBACK_PORT.description: Fixed port for the OAuth redirect callback.

MCP_REMOTE_SERVER_CONNECTION_BATCH_SIZE.description: Maximum number of remote MCP servers to connect in parallel (default: 20).

MCP_SERVER_CONNECTION_BATCH_SIZE.description: Maximum number of local MCP servers to connect in parallel (default: 3).

MCP_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in milliseconds for MCP server startup (default: 30000).

MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT.description: Timeout in milliseconds for MCP tool execution (default: 100000000).

NO_PROXY.description: List of domains and IPs to bypass proxy.

OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES.description: Emit API request/response JSON as log events (1 for inline, file:<dir> for disk).

OTEL_LOG_TOOL_CONTENT.description: Set to 1 to include tool input/output content in OpenTelemetry span events.

OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS.description: Set to 1 to include tool input arguments and details in traces and logs.

OTEL_LOG_USER_PROMPTS.description: Set to 1 to include user prompt text in OpenTelemetry traces and logs.

OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ACCOUNT_UUID.description: Set to false to exclude account UUID from metrics attributes.

OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_SESSION_ID.description: Set to false to exclude session ID from metrics attributes.

OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_VERSION.description: Set to true to include Claude Code version in metrics attributes.

SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET.description: Override the character budget for skill metadata shown to the Skill tool.

TASK_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH.description: Maximum characters in subagent output before truncation (default: 32000, max: 160000).

USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP.description: Set to 0 to use system-installed rg instead of the bundled ripgrep.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_3_5_HAIKU.description: Override region for Claude 3.5 Haiku on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_3_5_SONNET.description: Override region for Claude 3.5 Sonnet on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_3_7_SONNET.description: Override region for Claude 3.7 Sonnet on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_0_OPUS.description: Override region for Claude 4.0 Opus on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_0_SONNET.description: Override region for Claude 4.0 Sonnet on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_1_OPUS.description: Override region for Claude 4.1 Opus on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_5_OPUS.description: Override region for Claude Opus 4.5 on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_5_SONNET.description: Override region for Claude Sonnet 4.5 on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_6_OPUS.description: Override region for Claude Opus 4.6 on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_6_SONNET.description: Override region for Claude Sonnet 4.6 on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_4_7_OPUS.description: Override region for Claude Opus 4.7 on Vertex AI.

VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_HAIKU_4_5.description: Override region for Claude Haiku 4.5 on Vertex AI.
